name: Helicone
desc: One-line proxy observability for LLM API traffic
desc_zh: 改一行 base_url 即可接入的 LLM 流量观测代理，2026-03 被 Mintlify 收购
solves: Your model bill doubled and the provider's dashboard only shows totals. Point your base_url at Helicone and every call, cost and error shows up per user.
solves_zh: 模型账单翻倍，服务商的后台却只有总额。把 base_url 指向 Helicone，每次调用、成本和错误都按用户列出来。
best_for: When you need to attribute spend and failures to specific users or features.
best_for_zh: 当你需要把花费和失败归因到具体用户或功能时。
